issues.description: set_file_stat() uses unsafe extern chown(2) directly because the libc crate is not a declared dependency. Behaviour is equivalent to the C original but relies on platform ABI stability.
utime_file() uses unsafe extern utimensat() for POSIX 2008 nanosecond precision; std::fs::set_times() is nightly-only. Behaviour matches C ZSTD_USE_UTIMENSAT=1 path.
FileNamesTable.ref_filename() clones the string rather than storing a raw pointer as the C version does. External callers no longer need to manage string lifetime separately; behaviour is equivalent.

notes: Full migration of programs/util.c (1643 LoC) and programs/util.h (363 LoC). FileNamesTable converted from manual pointer/buffer management to Vec<String>. Platform-specific stat_t replaced with std::fs::Metadata. Core counting implemented natively for Linux (/proc/cpuinfo) and macOS (sysctlbyname). Directory traversal uses std::fs::read_dir. File compiles cleanly with zero warnings on stable Rust 2021 edition.
